literal: Difficult thing having endured, sorrowful pain having removed, separation having endured, after having stayed, they who live are many.
translation: Many are those who can endure the difficulty of parting, put away their sorrowful pain, bear the separation, and live on after he has left.
modern: பிரிவின் துன்பத்தைப் பொறுத்துக்கொண்டு, அதனால் வரும் துயர நோயை நீக்கி, பிரிவைத் தாங்கிக்கொண்டு காதலர் சென்ற பின்னும் உயிரோடு வாழ்பவர்கள் உலகில் பலர் இருக்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: The speaker expresses her inability to survive her lover's departure by contrasting herself with others. She notes that there are many people who can endure the difficult moment of parting, suppress their sorrowful pain, bear the ongoing separation, and continue to live on after their lover has left. By stating that many can do this, she implies that she herself is not one of them and will not survive the separation. The repetition of the word aṟṟi (having endured) emphasizes the heavy emotional burden that others somehow manage to carry, which she finds impossible.
